status: Canonical development interface, not an assertion about official source schemas
time: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamps; converted to KST. Numeric epoch and naive timestamps are rejected. Canonical ts is interval-end. decision_at must come from a locally verified issuance schedule.
unit_conversion: Canonical value = source value * configured scale + configured offset. Defaults describe synthetic fixtures only. Real provider units require official verification.
missing_weather: Missing row retained as NaN and indicator; train-fold median imputation; entirely missing training column uses zero plus indicator.
duplicates: Duplicate site-hour labels/targets, station-target-issue forecasts, and group-hour outputs are errors.
official_documents: Not located or supplied; real execution deliberately disabled. No real input files are read by the CLI.
